samir: :bubble_tea:

ash: tiny poll: who wants the leftover donuts tomorrow morning? react with :raised_hands: and i'll save some for remote folks (delivery codes welcome)

samir: recording the kazoo solo, will upload after karaoke. good vibes all around.
nala: big night — celebrate safe, take a nap if you need, and wfh tomorrow if you're wiped. See you on Zoom in ~5! :sparkling_heart:
